name: Deck Essentials for Spotify
author: grant

descriptions.en_US: Full Spotify playback control for Stream Deck and Stream Deck+: transport, seek, shuffle and repeat, volume and mute, Liked Songs, playlists, a one-key now-playing Song Stack, and four native Stream Deck+ dial actions. Uses your own Spotify Client ID with PKCE; no client secret.

short-descriptions.en_US: Control Spotify from keys and Stream Deck+ dials.
